name: Homm Saranam Baturiti
short_description: An 81-room wellness resort in Bali's cool-climate Bedugul highlands, roughly 90 minutes from the airport, with an on-site spa and rainforest/rice-terrace setting.
ai_summary: Homm Saranam Baturiti is an 81-room wellness resort in Bali's Bedugul highlands, surrounded by rainforest, rice terraces, and cool mountain air — a markedly different setting from Bali's beach resorts. The property offers rooms, suites, and pool villas, positioned for wellness retreats, yoga retreats, and romantic or family getaways, with its own 8LEMENTS Spa and easy access to Lake Bratan and the Jatiluwih Rice Terraces. It's roughly 90 minutes from Ngurah Rai International Airport. As a Homm-branded Accor ALL property, standard programme benefits apply.

core_facts.address: Kec. Baturiti, Kab. Tabanan, 82191 Bali, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 81 rooms, suites, and pool villas in a genuine highland/rainforest setting — a real alternative to Bali's beach resort cluster
On-site 8LEMENTS Spa and easy access to Lake Bratan and the Jatiluwih Rice Terraces (a UNESCO-listed landscape)
Cool mountain climate is a genuine differentiator from Bali's hot coastal resorts
cons: Roughly 90 minutes from the airport — a significant transfer compared with south Bali's resorts
No ALL Rating displayed yet — guest sentiment data not yet available
Remote wellness-resort positioning won't suit travellers wanting beach or nightlife access
